adblock-rust (matching engine)
==============================

Vendored assets: the adblock-rust 0.13.3 crate and the crates.io
                 dependencies cargo vendor resolved for it, under this
                 directory. The EasyList family is not here; it stays
                 in taffy-core/third_party/easylist/.
Owners:          The adblock-rust authors (MPL-2.0); TaffyGo decides
                 that this engine is the matcher (decision 0086)
Licence:         MPL-2.0 for adblock-rust itself
                 (vendor/adblock-v0_13/LICENSE). Transitive crates
                 keep the terms they arrived with, each next to its
                 sources — except two, whose published crate archives
                 contain no licence file at all: flatbuffers, which
                 declares Apache-2.0 in its Cargo.toml, and seahash,
                 which declares MIT. Their texts were fetched from the
                 repositories those manifests name and are here as
                 flatbuffers.Apache-2.0.txt and seahash.MIT.txt. The
                 Apache text is byte-identical to the copy already
                 tracked at taffy-core/third_party/dagger/LICENSE, and
                 seahash's upstream file carries no copyright line,
                 which is how upstream ships it.
Source:          https://github.com/brave/adblock-rust/
Version:         0.13.3

version=0.13.3
crate=adblock
url=https://github.com/brave/adblock-rust/
